property_summary: For any fuzzer-chosen block offset, settle() must revert while block.number has not yet passed the stored guess block (i.e. within 1 block of lockInGuess); the mutant deletes that check and lets settle() succeed early when the guess matches keccak256(blockhash of a not-yet-mined block) = keccak256(0).
change_summary: Delete the require that the current block is past the guess block, letting users settle before the guess block.
